title: JustHeal
description: A lightweight admin utility to heal, feed, or fully restore players with simple commands. Featuring clear text feedback and native support for 1.21.11.
body:
# ❤️ JustHeal
**The no-nonsense health and hunger management tool for admins.**

**JustHeal** is the latest addition to the "Just" plugin series. It provides a clean and efficient way to manage player vitals without the bloat of large "essentials" plugins. Perfectly optimized for **Minecraft 1.21.11 (Mounts of Mayhem)**.

---

### 🚀 Features
- **Heal Command:** Instantly restores health to maximum capacity.
- **Feed Command:** Fills the hunger bar (keeps current saturation).
- **Full Command:** The perfect combination—restores both health and food in one go.
- **Dynamic Targeting:** Use `/heal` to heal yourself or `/heal <player>` to assist others.
- **Clear Feedback:** Both the administrator and the player receive a green confirmation message in the chat.

---

### 🛠 Commands & Permissions
- `/heal [player]` - Restores health. (**justheal.admin**)
- `/feed [player]` - Refills hunger. (**justheal.admin**)
- `/full [player]` - Restores health & food. (**justheal.admin**)

*Permissions default to Operators (OP) only.*

---

### 📦 Technical Details
- **Version:** 1.21.x
- **Platform:** Spigot / Paper / Purpur.
- **Language:** English (for global compatibility).
- **Performance:** Ultra-lightweight with zero impact on TPS.

---

**JustHeal** – *Simple. Fast. Essential.*
